dataset.dev_note: dev = held-out template families for intents with >=5 families (else random 10%), process names from a third disjoint lexicon
dataset.teacher_model: templates/lexicons hand-authored in-session by an LLM coding agent; no paid API calls were made by the pipeline itself

learning_curve_note: 'learning_curve' used a fixed epoch budget and collapsed for <=10% data; 'learning_curve_step_equalised' scales epochs/patience by 1/fraction
